file_path.info: Select the Excel file to read

file_id_variable.info: Reference a file variable for file ID (e.g., {excelFileId}). Takes precedence over file selection if both provided.

sheet_index.info: Sheet number to read (0 for first sheet, 1 for second, etc.)

header_row.info: Which row to use as field names (1 for first row, 2 for second, etc.)

data_start_row.info: Starting row number for data (default: 2, meaning data starts from second row)

max_rows.info: Maximum number of rows to read (0 = read all rows)

preview_table.info: Preview the first 100 rows of data

errors.no_file_selected: Please select an Excel file first
errors.no_file_source: Please provide either a file selection or an external variable for file ID
errors.variable_not_resolved: Variable '{variable}' not found in runtime or global variables. Please check: (1) Variable is defined in Global Variables settings, or (2) Variable is passed in runtime variables when executing the flow.
